units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 5:6">Maasr. V, 6</cite> <he>המְתַמֵּד … ומצא כדי מדתו וכ׳</he> if one makes pomace wine, putting water on by measure, and finds (after pressing) the same quantity, he is exempt from giving tithes; <cite ref="Pesachim 42b:8">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00337"><he>רְוָוקָא</he> II</cite>.

B. Bath. 97ᵃ שתִּמְּדוּ במי גשמים (Ms. R. שתִּמְּדָן) when they used rain water to make tamad; Ḥull. 87ᵇ (by analogy from B. Bath. l. c.) שתמדו במי וכ׳ (Ms. R. שתמדן) when they diluted blood with rain water.

senses.gloss: to be infused, poured on. B. Bath. l. c. שנ׳ מאליו when the infusion came of itself (rain water fell upon it); Ḥull. l. c. שנִתְמְדוּ מאליהם.
